title: Show HN: DeepSeek V3 inference reimplemented in ~200 lines of JAX
summary: A Show HN project by VaibhaavTiwari reimplements DeepSeek V3 inference in roughly 200 lines of pure JAX. The code is presented as a readable, from-scratch reference rather than a production serving stack, and commenters singled out its educational clarity. Because it targets JAX rather than CUDA-specific tooling, readers also report using it as a starting point on AMD GPUs via ROCm, though that compatibility comes from user reports rather than a stated support commitment in the project description.
